steps.english: Join file "sap.hi0256" column "workday_employee_id" and file "wd.passport" column "Worker ID".
steps.autoNotes: A LEFT JOIN keeps every record from file 1 (sap.hi0256) and adds matching details from file 2 (wd.passport) when a match is found. Rows in file 2 (wd.passport) will not be kept if the keys "workday_employee_id" / "Worker ID" do not match. As a result, rows from file 1 (sap.hi0256) may contain NULL values if no match is found in file 2 (wd.passport).
steps.developer:
LEFT JOIN: keep all rows from the left source and matching rows from the right source when joining "sap.hi0256" on "workday_employee_id" to "wd.passport" on "Worker ID".

Excel:
=XLOOKUP([@[workday_employee_id]], wd_passport[Worker ID], wd_passport, "")

SQL Server:
FROM [sap.hi0256]
LEFT JOIN [wd.passport]
  ON [sap.hi0256].[workday_employee_id] = [wd.passport].[Worker ID]
